name: Zapier Central
tagline: Zapier Central, now Zapier Agents, for AI-driven workflows
description: Zapier Central is the AI agent layer inside Zapier, now branded Zapier Agents: build agents that read pages, pull data and act across your connections.
priceNote: Zapier Central was renamed Zapier Agents and ships inside the Zapier platform, where Professional starts at $19.99/month for 750 tasks and Team at $69/month, with limited agent activity included and larger allowances sold as add-ons. Pricing as of October 2026; plans change — check the official site.
bestFor: Small teams automating SaaS work without writing a line of code
pros: Thousands of app connectors mean most small-business tools connect without code
Agents handle the step that used to need a human: reading a page and pulling the data
A free tier covers small automations, so you can prove the value before paying anything
Tables and the interface builder add a small database and a front end on top of the workflows
cons: Pricing is charged per task, so a multi-step flow burns allowance far faster than expected
Agent runs consume separate activity credits on top of the task allowance
Deep automations get brittle: one upstream format change and the Zaps fail quietly
For high-volume flows the per-task cost is far above a code-based alternative

features.name: App connections
features.detail: Thousands of SaaS connectors with triggers, actions and webhooks

features.name: Agents
features.detail: AI steps that read pages, extract fields and act in other apps

features.name: Tables and interfaces
features.detail: A database and a simple front end built on the same underlying data

features.name: Multi-step Zaps
features.detail: Paths, filters, loops and reusable sub-Zaps for branching logic

features.name: Code steps
features.detail: JavaScript or Python inside a flow when a connector is not enough

features.name: Templates and sharing
features.detail: Community templates plus a shared library for the whole team

useCases: Copy every new form submission into a CRM, a spreadsheet and a chat channel at once
Let an agent read a supplier invoice and draft the bookkeeping entry for a human to approve
Connect a small online store to email marketing, support and accounting without developers
Post every finished video to three social channels on a schedule
bestForWho: Small teams with no developer who need to connect SaaS tools and automate the routine handoffs between them.
verdict: Zapier Central, now Zapier Agents, is the most practical way for a small team to automate SaaS work without hiring a developer, and the agent layer is what makes it competitive again because it can read a page and pull the field a connector cannot. The classic Zaps are still the reason most teams stay, since the connector library covers nearly every tool a small business uses. The cost model is the trap: you are billed per task, so a five-step flow consumes five tasks per run, and agent runs add a separate activity allowance on top. Anyone who has had a Zap fail silently at 2am learns to monitor them. For straightforward handoffs it is unbeatable; for high-volume, code it instead.
